1.title: 5 Things to Know About Francesca Hong, the Progressive Running for Wisconsin Governor
1.summary: The state assemblywoman, a democratic socialist, is a chef and former small business owner. Her campaign focused on economic issues.

2.title: 5 Things to Know About Tom Tiffany, Republican Gubernatorial Candidate in Wisconsin
2.summary: Representative Tom Tiffany is running with President Trump’s backing.

3.title: 5 Things to Know About Michael Alfonso, Sean Duffy’s Son-in-Law in Wisconsin’s 7th District Race
3.summary: If elected, Mr. Alfonso, 26, would be the youngest member of Congress, thanks in no small part to the support his father-in-law, Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy, and an endorsement from President Trump.

4.title: As Death Toll From Colombia Earthquake Rises to at Least 181, Rescuers Hunt for Survivors
4.summary: “We heard them screaming,” said one rescuer in Cali, where emergency workers and volunteers are racing against time to find the living trapped in the rubble.

5.title: Trump's dramatic plane swap hints at personal stakes of Iran war
5.summary: It marks another striking episode in the turbulent history of his relationship with Iran, writes Anthony Zurcher.

6.title: Cristiano Ronaldo marries long-time partner Georgina Rodríguez
6.summary: The Portuguese superstar has posted an image of two hands - presumed to be his on top of his wife's - both wearing wedding rings.
